subject: Social Media
title: FOMO and Urgency
description: A 60-second lesson on FOMO and Urgency.

hook.text: Everyone's talking about a show you haven't watched. You feel anxious, left out, behind. That's FOMO.

buildup.text: Fear of missing out drives sharing because participating in trends is a social survival mechanism.

discovery.text: Scarcity amplifies FOMO. Limited drops, expiring stories, countdown timers—all trigger urgent sharing.

twist.text: FOMO is ancient. Humans evolved to monitor group activities. Missing a feast meant starving alone.

climax.text: Platforms weaponize FOMO with ephemeral content. Stories vanish in 24 hours—share now or lose it.

punchline.text: If you can miss it, you must share it.

quiz.question: Why do disappearing stories drive more sharing?
options: Scarcity triggers FOMO and urgent sharing
